text: I almost didn't go to the climate march last weekend, it was raining and I'd told myself I'd just watch it online instead. But my sister called and guilt-tripped me into it, so there I was, soaked, holding a sign I'd made badly in about ten minutes. Climate change remains one of the most pressing challenges facing humanity today, and addressing it requires a multifaceted approach, including reduced carbon emissions, ecosystem protection, and collective individual action.
